text:
maria-eng: Quick FYI: EU staging is seeing sporadic `invalid_signature` errors immediately after SDK v3.2 canary. Small % but reproducible.

sam-plat: Noted. Stacktrace implicates runtime shim header parsing during chunked/streamed responses. Looks like a serialization tweak in SDK 3.2.

irina-qa: Can you paste a repro? Ill run a focused smoke across eu-west-1/eu-central-1.

maria-eng: Repro: start a streaming chat payload >1kb. Response mid-stream 400 with `invalid_signature`.

kev-release: Deploybot, pin runtime upgrades in EU until we triage. /deploybot pin region=eu runtime=2.14 reason="sdk-3.2 streaming header mismatch"

deploybot: @kev-release acknowledged. Pin applied: runtime=2.14 locked in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1. (action_id=pb-7892)

jon-prod: Good. We need clear rollback gates.

maria-eng: Proposal: telemetry gate = `invalid_signature` >0.25% for 15m OR user error rate delta +0.5% -> trigger rollback to previous routing and run rollback playbook.

irina-qa: Running the streaming >1kb regression now. ETA ~18m. Also validating with SDK v3.1 baseline.

sam-plat: Quick workaround candidate: normalize header key casing in runtime shim before signature verification. Pushing a micro-patch to test.

kev-release: Update release notes: "EU: runtime upgrades on hold due to SDK 3.2 streaming incompatibility". Also extend canary hold by +2h.

deploybot: Freeze active until 1719998400 UTC or manual lift by @kev-release.

irina-qa: Confirmed in staging: streaming failure reproducible on SDK 3.2. Pasted minimal reproducer snippet in #eng-runtime.

sam-plat: Micro-patch deployed to micro-canary (eu-west-1-usermock). Monitoring.

maria-eng: If micro-canary + full QA green, do staged unpin: 50% traffic for 10m then 100%. Keep the regional pin for other variants until stable.

kev-release: Agreed. Staged unpin plan + rollback trigger documented.

deploybot: micro-canary deploy started (deploy_id=pb-7892-b). Will report metrics to #eng-runtime.

jon-prod: Thanks. Keep updates here; escalate to incidents if we hit rollback. :thumbsup:
